confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of San Diego and comparable US West Coast cities; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by neighborhood and by July peak-season demand. Meal prices assume US tipping conventions; tips are not included in the inexpensive-meal or two-person mid-range figures because US tips are not added to the bill. The FX observation (2026-10-15) was taken from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates page. I could not open the RBA page to confirm it. A 2026-10-16 figure was also reported but may not be published yet before the 4 pm Sydney fix, so I used the prior business day.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the US West Coast mid-sized visitor market, similar to Los Angeles pricing but somewhat lower for hotels and dining. Anchors were set using typical San Diego restaurant, craft-beer, and café prices and summer hotel and hostel rates.
